body:
Flagged by AI reviewer in PR #1783.

## Problem

`nomad/jobs/edge.hcl`'s snapshot task is `raw_exec`. It writes `SNAPSHOT_PATH` directly to `/srv/disinto/snapshot-state/state.json` because host_volume mounts do not apply. It has never set `THREADS_ROOT`.

`bin/snapshot-inbox.sh` `scan_completed_threads` defaults `THREADS_ROOT` to `/var/lib/disinto/threads` and returns `[]` when that directory is missing. On the Nomad host, delegate thread state lives at `/srv/disinto/threads-state` (`nomad/client.hcl`, `lib/init/nomad/cluster-up.sh`). The GC job remaps that volume to `/var/lib/disinto/threads` inside its own container (`nomad/jobs/edge-threads-gc.hcl`); the snapshot daemon does not. Completed delegate threads therefore never enter `state.json` inbox from the live snapshot task.

This predates #1770 (that PR only removed `INBOX_ROOT`; `THREADS_ROOT` was already unset).

## Expected

Set `THREADS_ROOT=/srv/disinto/threads-state` on the snapshot task, matching how `SNAPSHOT_PATH` bypasses volume_mount.

---
*Auto-created from AI review*
## Affected files
- `nomad/jobs/edge.hcl` — snapshot task env block (sets `SNAPSHOT_PATH` but never `THREADS_ROOT`)
- `bin/snapshot-inbox.sh` — `scan_completed_threads` defaults `THREADS_ROOT` to `/var/lib/disinto/threads` and returns `[]` when missing

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The snapshot task in `nomad/jobs/edge.hcl` sets `THREADS_ROOT=/srv/disinto/threads-state` in its env block, matching how `SNAPSHOT_PATH` bypasses volume_mount.
- [ ] On the live Nomad host, `bin/snapshot-inbox.sh` `scan_completed_threads` reports completed delegate threads (state at `/srv/disinto/threads-state`) into the inbox instead of returning `[]`.
- [ ] `SNAPSHOT_PATH` behavior is unchanged; no regression to existing snapshot state writes.

Flagged by AI reviewer in PR #1775.

## Problem

#1758 removes the Claude binary and credential mounts from `docker/edge/dispatcher.sh` on the claim that runners and sidecars no longer need them because `AGENT_HARNESS` defaults to dsh (#1683). That default only covers `lib/agent-sdk.sh` `agent_run`. These callers do not use it:

- `docker/reproduce/entrypoint-reproduce.sh` fatals if `claude` is not on `PATH` (expects a host mount of `/usr/local/bin/claude`) and then runs `claude -p`. `docker/reproduce/Dockerfile` does not install the CLI. `_dispatch_sidecar_docker` is the only implemented sidecar backend (`_dispatch_sidecar_nomad` returns 1) and is what `dispatch_reproduce`, `dispatch_triage`, and `dispatch_verify` launch (`disinto-reproduce:latest`).
- `docker/runner/entrypoint-runner.sh` `exec`s `claude -p` for every `formulas/<name>.toml` vault action. It does not consult `AGENT_HARNESS`. On the edge job, auth is the `claude-shared` OAuth mount (`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`), not `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` (explicitly unset in `nomad/jobs/edge.hcl`).

Until those entrypoints move to the dsh harness (or stop calling Claude), the dispatcher mounts are load-bearing. Dropping them makes sidecar launches exit 1 and makes `.toml` vault formulas fail closed.

---
*Auto-created from AI review*
## Affected files
- `docker/reproduce/entrypoint-reproduce.sh` — fatals on missing `claude` and expects a host mount of `/usr/local/bin/claude`
- `docker/runner/entrypoint-runner.sh` — `exec`s `claude -p` for every `formulas/<name>.toml` vault action
- `docker/edge/dispatcher.sh` — currently drops the Claude binary/credential mounts that these entrypoints still depend on

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `docker/reproduce/entrypoint-reproduce.sh` no longer fatals when `claude` is absent and no longer requires a host mount of `/usr/local/bin/claude`.
- [ ] Sidecar launches via `dispatch_reproduce`, `dispatch_triage`, and `dispatch_verify` succeed without Claude credentials or the CLI on PATH.
- [ ] `docker/runner/entrypoint-runner.sh` runs `.toml` vault formulas through the dsh harness (`AGENT_HARNESS`) and no longer `exec`s `claude -p`.
- [ ] `.toml` vault formulas execute on the edge job; the dispatcher's Claude mounts are no longer load-bearing.

title: docs(nomad): fix stale edge-job docs bundled from tech-debt #1785, #1780, #1779
body:
Bundled from tech-debt dust items #1785, #1780, #1779 — stale documentation about the Nomad edge job left after the #1770/#1769/#1768/#1778 edge rework. Documentation-only; no behavior change.

- #1785: `nomad/AGENTS.md` "The chat job is init-generated" section still says chat is served in-process via `chat-server.py`. Update to say chat is no longer served by the edge job (#1768/#1769) and align the drift/doctor wording with the current generated state.
- #1780: `nomad/AGENTS.md` edge row still describes Caddyfile upstreams as `127.0.0.1` (forgejo :3000, woodpecker :8000) and a `/woodpecker` route. Update to match the jobspec's generated Caddyfile (`nomadService` upstreams, no loopback, no `/woodpecker`).
- #1779: `nomad/jobs/edge.hcl` header (lines ~28-30) still says the `docker-compose.yml` stack is live until the cutover. Update to say the Nomad+Vault backend is the live stack (cutover is complete).

## Affected files
- `nomad/AGENTS.md`
- `nomad/jobs/edge.hcl`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `nomad/AGENTS.md` "The chat job is init-generated" section reflects that chat is no longer served by the edge job.
- [ ] `nomad/AGENTS.md` edge row reflects the jobspec's Caddyfile (`nomadService` upstreams, no loopback, no `/woodpecker` route).
- [ ] `nomad/jobs/edge.hcl` header reflects that the Nomad+Vault backend is the live stack (no docker-compose cutover note).
- [ ] No behavioral or jobspec changes; documentation-only.
